title: Logitech G502 HERO
description: The Logitech G502 HERO is the best-selling gaming mouse shape of its generation, built around the 25,600 DPI HERO optical sensor. Eleven programmable buttons and an adjustable weight system let players tune it precisely. The dual-mode scroll wheel flips between clicky and free-spin with a button press.

demo.program:
# Logitech G502 HERO: polling latency + physical travel math
dpi_max = 25600
polling_hz = 1000
latency_ms = 1000 / polling_hz
counts_per_mm = dpi_max / 25.4
print(f"Poll interval at {polling_hz} Hz: {latency_ms:.2f} ms")
print(f"Counts per mm of travel: {counts_per_mm:.0f}")
# physical travel to cross a 3440 px ultrawide at 800 DPI with 2x OS multiplier
px = 3440; eff_dpi = 800 * 2
mm = px / eff_dpi * 25.4
print(f"Travel to cross 3440 px @ 800 DPI x2: {mm:.1f} mm")
